name: Party T-Rex
desc: A synthwave T-rex in neon sunglasses that stomps with a screen-shake bob, pumps its tiny arms and cracks its jaw open in periodic roaring builds over a glowing neon horizon.

scale.doc: size vs design (hero fills frame at max)

pose.doc: choreography: stomp=big footfalls+bob / fistpump=arms drive / strut=walk-in-place / idle=gentle sway

style.doc: aesthetic: neon=glowing tube outlines+scanlines / chrome=airbrushed metallic no glow / wireframe=fill-less polygon mesh / vhs=RGB-split glitch tear

act.doc: dramaturgy: party=obey pose / roar=periodic build to a wide-jaw roar with expanding neon rings
